narrative.overview: Steward feels like opening a beautifully edited private briefing at the start of the day. Character lives in the writing, editorial scale shift, honey signal surfaces, and the deep blue-violet voice of Steward itself. Automation stays quiet, legible, and subordinate.
keyCharacteristics: True-white daylight surface with a rare honey signal
Serif only for authored judgment and high-level numbers

rules.name: The Honey Rarity Rule
rules.body: Honey may carry one dominant surface and a small set of active signals per viewport.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif expresses synthesis and judgment. Sans expresses evidence, controls, status, and navigation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a container needs a wide soft shadow to feel separate, its spacing or tonal role is wrong.

dos: Do lead every return visit with one plain-language change story.
Do reserve Honey Signal for the most important status or time cue.
Do show measured, inferred, unavailable, and too-early-to-call states explicitly.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS admin dashboards from identical metric cards.
Don't use hacker terminals, cyber-security theatrics, or alarming red system monitors.
Don't reproduce cleaner-app urgency, hidden risk, or one-click deletion.
